project_description: A desktop calculator capable of performing basic arithmetic through a simple graphical interface using Python and Tkinter.

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Support numeric input (0-9), decimal point and multi-digit numbers.
acceptance_criteria.description: Digits 0 through 9 append correctly to the current input display.
preconditions: Calculator is powered on and display is active

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Support numeric input (0-9), decimal point and multi-digit numbers.
acceptance_criteria.description: Only one decimal point is allowed per operand.
expected_outputs: Decimal point added if not already present in the current operand
preconditions: Current operand does not contain a decimal point
postconditions: Decimal point is displayed in the current operand

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Support numeric input (0-9), decimal point and multi-digit numbers.
acceptance_criteria.description: Multi-digit numbers are supported and displayed correctly as sequential digits are entered.
expected_outputs: Combined multi-digit number shown in display
postconditions: Display reflects the full multi-digit number

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Perform Addition (+), Subtraction (-), Multiplication (*) and Division (/).
acceptance_criteria.description: Addition operation calculates the sum of two or more operands correctly.

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Perform Addition (+), Subtraction (-), Multiplication (*) and Division (/).
acceptance_criteria.description: Subtraction operation calculates the difference between operands correctly.

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Perform Addition (+), Subtraction (-), Multiplication (*) and Division (/).
acceptance_criteria.description: Multiplication operation calculates the product of operands correctly.

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Perform Addition (+), Subtraction (-), Multiplication (*) and Division (/).
acceptance_criteria.description: Division operation calculates the quotient of operands correctly.
preconditions: Valid numeric operands provided and divisor is not zero

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Provide Clear (C) to reset all calculator state.
acceptance_criteria.description: Clear (C) button resets all calculator state, memory, and display to initial zero or empty state.
preconditions: Calculator has active input, result, or error state
postconditions: Calculator is reset to initial state

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Provide Delete (DEL) to remove the last entered character.
acceptance_criteria.description: Delete (DEL) button removes the last entered character from the input display.
preconditions: Display contains at least one character
postconditions: Display lacks the most recently entered character

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Validate division by zero BEFORE division and display an error message instead of performing the calculation.
acceptance_criteria.description: Division by zero is detected before calculation and triggers an error message display instead of executing the operation.
preconditions: Expression includes division where the divisor evaluates to zero
postconditions: Error message is shown on the display

acceptance_criteria.requirement_title: Evaluate the expression when '=' is pressed.
acceptance_criteria.description: Equals (=) button triggers the evaluation of the current mathematical expression.
preconditions: A complete, valid mathematical expression is entered
postconditions: Expression is evaluated and result is ready for display

acceptance_criteria.description: Calculated results are formatted correctly and presented in the display field.
expected_outputs: Formatted numeric result in display field
